run_create_uma_finetune_dataset_cli: run the CLI script to process ASE atoms directories and generate YAML configs for UMA model finetuning
create_yaml_finetune_configs: create YAML data task and finetune template configs from processed train and validation dataset paths
launch_processing_ase_atoms: launch parallel processing to convert a directory of ASE atoms objects into a structured dataset format
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from a processed training dataset directory
review_create_yaml_function: review the create_yaml function that populates UMA finetune template YAMLs with dataset paths and model parameters
